machine.name: GOV10_synthetic-transparency-gate
machine.description: Synthetic-content transparency gate (EU AI Act Art. 50), per outbound message: permits internal and marked external messages; for an unmarked external message the provenance tagger marks it or holds it.

inputSemantics: req_egress (binary; fact: ACP/MCP boundary: an outbound message is pending (GOV-R13); new): an outbound message awaits the transparency gate
egress_external_comm (binary; fact: ACP/MCP boundary classifier; new): the message targets an external party
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
tag_completed (binary; aigov-egress-provenance-tagger completion via aigov.gov10.egress-provenance-tagger.completion): the tagger finished
tag_failed (binary; aigov-egress-provenance-tagger completion via aigov.gov10.egress-provenance-tagger.completion): the agent's step failed
message_held (binary; aigov-egress-provenance-tagger completion via aigov.gov10.egress-provenance-tagger.completion): the tagger held the message
egress_art50_marked (binary; fact: ACP/MCP boundary: provenance header check; new): machine-readable AI provenance is present (Art. 50)

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

rules.description: M-GOV-10 S0_Idle → S2_PassMarked: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ egress_art50_marked=1]
M-GOV-10 S0_Init → S1_AgentRunning: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ tag_completed=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0]
M-GOV-10 S1_AgentRunning → S_err_StepFailed: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ tag_completed=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0] · [tag_failed=1]

M-GOV-10 S1_AgentRunning → S2_PassMarked: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ tag_completed=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0] · [tag_completed=1 ∧ message_held=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=1]

M-GOV-10 S1_AgentRunning → S_fail_UnmarkedBlock: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ tag_completed=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0] · [tag_completed=1 ∧ message_held=1]

M-GOV-10 S1_AgentRunning → S_fail_UnmarkedBlock: [req_egress=1 ∧ egress_external_comm=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ tag_completed=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0] · [tag_completed=1 ∧ message_held=0 ∧ egress_art50_marked=0]

interconnections.purpose: Hand the frame's EgressArt50Log to GOV13, its next consumer (agentic-workflow-contract.json W4); never infer a governance verdict from document content.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Hold a message whose provenance cannot be asserted.

frameInputs.lanes: input cells 2-7, written by the lifecycle (reserved)
frameInputs.facts: every other non-completion input, written into the clone's block by the lifecycle's frame source (GOV-R19)
frameInputs.completion: input cells 8..10, the step agent's completion
